newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Ukrainian soldier shot NATO comrade by mistake.
newsitem.headline: Ukrainian soldier shot NATO comrade by mistake.

text.p: A Ukrainian soldier in Bosnia's NATO-led peace force shot dead a comrade after mistaking him for an intruder while both were guarding a sensitive elections site in Sarajevo, NATO said on Monday.

First reports of the shooting overnight on Sunday said the soldier was shot by assailants while on sentry duty outside a warehouse filled with voting materials for Bosnia's first post-war general elections on September 14.
But a NATO spokesman said an investigation determined that the Ukrainian sentry was shot by another in a tragic error.

"Shortly after midnight there were reports of an intruder in the general area of the warehouse and two Ukrainian sentries conducted a patrol to check the security perimeter," Major Brett Boudreau told a news conference.

"After completing the search and finding nothing, one of the soldiers climbed into the group's armoured personnel carrier. As he did so, he was startled to see someone inside and, believing it to be an intruder, fired a shot that killed the soldier.
The warehouse held ballots and other materials for the elections, which are being supervised by the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe.
